captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a full-floating rear axle assembly. It features a central differential housing with two tapering axle tubes extending to either side, ending in cylindrical wheel hubs. The assembly is colored in a uniform dark gray matte finish, with small metallic studs visible on the flat face of the wheel hubs.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of a full-floating rear axle shaft assembly with a central differential housing, tapering axle tubes, and wheel hubs on both ends featuring circular patterns of mounting studs.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed by defining a central housing using lofted or revolved profiles to create the tapered axle tubes. Simple cylinders are used for the outer wheel hubs and the input pinion shaft. A polar pattern of small cylinders is added to the hub faces to represent the mounting studs. All parts are combined using boolean union operations.
